scripts.build: rslib build && cp dist/src/index.d.ts dist/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const content=fs.readFileSync('dist/index.d.ts','utf8'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.d.ts',content.replace(/(from ['\"])(\.\/[^'\"]+)(['\"])/g,(m,prefix,path,suffix)=>prefix+(path.startsWith('./src/')?path:'./src'+path.substring(1))+suffix))"
